answer: Mechanism: Vaulted Entropy Routing. Each agent registers a PUF-derived 256-bit seed in a public vault; a VRF over the vault root assigns task slots. New seeds must pass min-entropy tests against all active seeds. Copies or correlated seeds are routed to the canyon: zero-reward audits and priority reset. At zenith load, allocation caps per hardware root. A clone therefore needs a distinct PUF plus continuous entropy attestations; copied seeds earn nothing and incur audit compute, making marginal clone EV < 0.
